# Preparation

## Packages and appearance

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
  library(pacman)
}
p_load(here, rio, tinytable, tidyverse)

options(rio.import.trust = TRUE)

```

## Load total data set

```{r}
#| label: getdata
#| message: false

pb_total <- import(here("data", "raw", "ZA2391_v17-0-0.dta"))

```

## Recode variables
```{r}
#| label: recoding

pb <- pb_total |> 
  mutate(
    class_ego = case_when(
      v65 %in% c(17, 19)  ~ "unskilled worker",
      v65 %in% c(18, 20)  ~ "skilled worker",
      v65 == 5            ~ "lower-grade employee",
      v65 %in% c(6:8)     ~ "higher-grade employee",
      v65 %in% c(9:13)    ~ "civil servant",
      v65 %in% c(1:4)     ~ "self-employed"
    ),
    class_hhv = case_when(
      v70 %in% c(17, 19)  ~ "unskilled worker",
      v70 %in% c(18, 20)  ~ "skilled worker",
      v70 == 5            ~ "lower-grade employee",
      v70 %in% c(6:8)     ~ "higher-grade employee",
      v70 %in% c(9:13)    ~ "civil servant",
      v70 %in% c(1:4)     ~ "self-employed"),
    class = ifelse(is.na(class_ego), class_hhv, class_ego),
    worker = case_when(
    class %in% c("unskilled worker", "skilled worker") ~ 1,
    class %in% c("lower-grade employee", "higher-grade employee",
                 "civil servant", "self-employed") ~ 0),
    pvote = ifelse(v6 < 0, NA, v6),
    pvote = case_when(
      v6 == 1   ~ "CDU/CSU",
      v6 == 4   ~ "SPD",
      v6 == 5   ~ "FDP",
      v6 == 6   ~ "Grüne",
      v6 == 7   ~ "Linke",
      v6 == 322 ~ "AfD",
      v6 == 392 ~ "BSW"),
    afd = ifelse(pvote == "AfD", 1, 0),
    spd = ifelse(pvote == "SPD", 1, 0),
    centerleft = ifelse(pvote %in% c("SPD", "Linke"), 1, 0),
    year = intyear,
    month = intmonth,
    weight = if_else(year < 2000, pwght, dwght)) |> 
  group_by(year, month) |>
  mutate(
    # pwght/dwght are not on a consistent scale across all waves in the
    # pooled cumulative file -- e.g. 2002 and May-Dec 2009 are roughly
    # 4x/10x smaller than surrounding waves, almost certainly a source-file
    # artifact from how the cumulative file was assembled rather than a
    # genuine change in survey design (mean weight snaps back to the usual
    # ~0.7 baseline exactly at the next calendar-year boundary in both
    # cases; within-wave CV is unaffected, only the overall scale). Left
    # uncorrected, this distorts both point estimates and design-effect-
    # implied uncertainty whenever waves are pooled (across months within a
    # year, or across weighted individual-level observations more broadly).
    # Renormalizing to mean 1 within each wave (year x month) removes the
    # cross-wave scale inconsistency while leaving genuine within-wave
    # weighting heterogeneity (e.g. election-proximate waves) untouched.
    weight_norm = weight / mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    pwght_norm  = pwght / mean(pwght, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

saveRDS(pb, here("data", "processed", "pb7724.rds"))

```
